# Helloleads

HelloLeads is a smart and simple lead management solution designed for small businesses to streamline lead capture, tracking, and engagement.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/helloleads/.

## Actions

- **Create Lead**: Add a new lead into HelloLeads.
- **List Leads** (read-only): List all leads from HelloLeads.
- **List Lead Lists** (read-only): Retrieve all lead list keys from HelloLeads.
